articles.title: Messi's 8th Goal Breaks Deadlock, But Mbappe and Haaland Lurk Close Behind
articles.summary: Lionel Messi's 8th goal against Egypt puts him alone atop the Golden Boot standings. Kylian Mbappe and Erling Haaland have 7 each as the quarterfinals begin.

articles.title: How a Georgia Factory Solved Its Worker Shortage by Ditching the 40-Hour Week
articles.summary: GE Appliances' Roper plant in Georgia faced a severe labor shortage. By offering flexible four-hour shifts via an app, it attracted 450 part-time workers and expanded operations.

articles.title: Federal Judge Blocks Trump Bid for Georgia Election Worker Data; NYC Building at Risk
articles.summary: A judge rejected the Trump administration's subpoena for Fulton County election workers' personal info. Separately, a Manhattan high-rise conversion project suffered a structural failure, prompting evacuations.
